sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, who sit top of the table with 22 points from 10 games and an impressive recent run of five wins and a draw, face Alsager Town at home on Saturday 3 October. Alsager are struggling badly in 19th place with just 4 points, having lost their last five games, so Sandbach will be heavy favourites to extend their unbeaten streak.
divisionWide: The chasing pack will be eager to close the gap on Sandbach. Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town in a match between mid-table sides, while third-placed AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall in what could be a competitive encounter between two strong performers; Eccleshall sit 5th but are without a win in their last outing. Wolverhampton Casuals, also in the top four, welcome Wednesfield Community to a fixture where form suggests the visitors may struggle. Bilston Town, 6th and in-form with consecutive wins, travel to Foley Meir. Barnton host Shawbury United in a meeting of inconsistent sides; Barnton have picked up a win recently while Shawbury remain winless in their last five. Crewe entertain Allscott Heath in a clash between lower-mid-table teams, while Brereton Social face Widnes Town—a particularly lopsided fixture given Widnes sit bottom with just 2 points and have not won a single game. New Mills travel to Market Drayton Town, with both teams searching for consistency. Cheadle Heath Nomads visit Telford Town in another fixture featuring struggling sides at the foot of the table.
